segments.vv83:1.3: Bāhā paggayha kandasi, vanamajjhe kiṃ dukkhito tuvan”ti.
segments.vv83:2.3: Tassa cakkayugaṃ na vindāmi, tena dukkhena jahāmi [jahissaṃ (sī.), jahissāmi (syā. pī.)] jīvitan”ti.
segments.vv83:3.1: “Sovaṇṇamayaṃ maṇimayaṃ, lohitakamayaṃ [lohitaṅgamayaṃ (syā.), lohitaṅkamayaṃ (sī.), lohamayaṃ (katthaci)] atha rūpiyamayaṃ;
segments.vv83:3.3: Ācikkha [ācikkhatha (ka.)] me bhaddamāṇava, cakkayugaṃ paṭipādayāmi te”ti.
segments.vv83:4.1: So māṇavo tassa pāvadi,“candimasūriyā ubhayettha dissare;
segments.vv83:4.3: Sovaṇṇamayo ratho mama, tena cakkayugena sobhatī”ti.
segments.vv83:5.1: “Bālo kho tvaṃ asi māṇava, yo tvaṃ patthayase apatthiyaṃ;
segments.vv83:5.3: Maññāmi tuvaṃ marissasi, na hi tvaṃ lacchasi candimasūriye”ti.
segments.vv83:6.3: Peto [peto pana (sī. syā.)] kālakato na dissati, ko nidha kandataṃ bālyataro”ti.
segments.vv83:7.1: “Saccaṃ kho vadesi māṇava, ahameva kandataṃ bālyataro;
segments.vv83:7.3: Candaṃ viya dārako rudaṃ, petaṃ kālakatābhipatthayin”ti.
segments.vv83:8.3: Vārinā viya osiñcaṃ, sabbaṃ nibbāpaye daraṃ.
segments.vv83:9.1: “Abbahī [abbūḷha (pī.), abbūḷhaṃ (syā. ka.)] vata me sallaṃ, sokaṃ hadayanissitaṃ;
segments.vv83:10.3: Na socāmi na rodāmi, vata sutvāna māṇavāti.
segments.vv83:11.1: “Devatā nusi gandhabbo, adu [ādu (sī. syā.)] sakko purindado;
segments.vv83:11.3: Ko vā tvaṃ kassa vā putto, kathaṃ jānemu taṃ mayan”ti.
segments.vv83:12.1: “Yañca [yaṃ (ka.)] kandasi yañca rodasi, puttaṃ āḷāhane sayaṃ dahitvā;
segments.vv83:12.3: Svāhaṃ kusalaṃ karitvā kammaṃ, tidasānaṃ sahabyataṃ gato”ti [pattoti (sī. syā. pī.)].
segments.vv83:13.1: “Appaṃ vā bahuṃ vā nāddasāma, dānaṃ dadantassa sake agāre;
segments.vv83:13.3: Uposathakammaṃ vā [uposathakammañca (ka.)] tādisaṃ, kena kammena gatosi devalokan”ti.
segments.vv83:14.3: Buddhaṃ vigatarajaṃ vitiṇṇakaṅkhaṃ, addakkhiṃ sugataṃ anomapaññaṃ.
segments.vv83:15.3: Tāhaṃ kusalaṃ karitvāna kammaṃ, tidasānaṃ sahabyataṃ gato”ti.
segments.vv83:16.1: “Acchariyaṃ vata abbhutaṃ vata, añjalikammassa ayamīdiso vipāko;
segments.vv83:16.3: Ahampi muditamano pasannacitto, ajjeva buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ vajāmī”ti.
segments.vv83:17.1: “Ajjeva buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ vajāhi, dhammañca saṅghañca pasannacitto;
segments.vv83:17.3: Tatheva sikkhāya padāni pañca, akhaṇḍaphullāni samādiyassu.
segments.vv83:18.3: Amajjapo mā ca musā bhaṇāhi, sakena dārena ca hohi tuṭṭho”ti.
segments.vv83:19.3: Karomi tuyhaṃ vacanaṃ, tvaṃsi ācariyo mamāti.
segments.vv83:21.3: Amajjapo no ca musā bhaṇāmi, sakena dārena ca homi tuṭṭho”ti.

lines: Maṭṭhakuṇḍalīti sarīrappadesassa aghaṃsanatthaṃ mālālatādayo adassetvā maṭṭhākāreneva katakuṇḍalo.
Atha vā maṭṭhakuṇḍalīti visuddhakuṇḍalo, tāpetvā jātihiṅgulikāya majjitvā dhovitvā sūkaralomena majjitakuṇḍaloti attho.
Kiṃdukkhitoti vā ekameva padaṃ, kena dukkhena dukkhitoti attho.
Tassa cakkayugaṃ na vindāmi, tena dukkhena jahāmi jīvitan”ti.
Ācikkha me bhaddamāṇava, cakkayugaṃ paṭipādayāmi te”ti.

Taṃ sutvā māṇavo “ayaṃ puttassa bhesajjaṃ akatvā puttapatirūpakaṃ maṃ disvā rodanto ‘suvaṇṇādimayaṃ rathacakkaṃ karomī’ti vadati, hotu niggaṇhissāmi nan”ti cintetvā “kīva mahantaṃ me cakkayugaṃ karissasī”ti vatvā “yāva mahantaṃ ākaṅkhasī”ti vutte “candimasūriyehi me attho, te me dehī”ti yācanto –
“So māṇavo tassa pāvadi, candasūriyā ubhayettha dissare;
Sovaṇṇamayo ratho mama, tena cakkayugena sobhatī”ti.
“Bālo kho tvaṃ asi māṇava, yo tvaṃ patthayase apatthiyaṃ;
Maññāmi tuvaṃ marissasi, na hi tvaṃ lacchasi candasūriye”ti.
Atha naṃ māṇavo “kiṃ pana paññāyamānassatthāya rodanto bālo hoti, udāhu apaññāyamānassā”ti vatvā –
Peto kālakato na dissati, ko nidha kandataṃ bālyataro”ti.
Taṃ sutvā brāhmaṇo “yuttaṃ esa vadatī”ti sallakkhetvā –
“Saccaṃ kho vadesi māṇava, ahameva kandataṃ bālyataro;
Candaṃ viya dārako rudaṃ, petaṃ kālakatābhipatthayin”ti.
Vatvā tassa kathāya nissoko hutvā māṇavassa thutiṃ karonto imā gāthā abhāsi –
Vārinā viya osiñcaṃ, sabbaṃ nibbāpaye daraṃ.
Na socāmi na rodāmi, tava sutvāna māṇavā”ti.
Paṭipādayāmīti sampādetvā dadāmi, mā cakkayugābhāvena jīvitaṃ jahīti adhippāyo.
Ubhayettha dissareti ubhopi ettha candasūriyā ākāse dissanti.
Gamanāgamananti divase divase ogamanuggamanavasena candasūriyānaṃ gamanaṃ āgamanañca dissati.
Vaṇṇadhātūti sītibhāvavisiṭṭhā kantabhāvabhāsurā, uṇhabhāvavisiṭṭhā tikkhabhāvabhāsurā ca vaṇṇanibhā.
Ubhayatthāti cande sūriye cāti dvīsupi vaṇṇadhātu dissatīti yojetabbaṃ.
Imaṃ pana kathaṃ sutvā “alabbhanīyavatthuṃ vatāhaṃ patthetvā kevalaṃ sokagginā ḍayhāmi, kiṃ me niratthakena anayabyasanenā”ti paṭisaṅkhāne aṭṭhāsi.
Atha devaputto maṭṭhakuṇḍalīrūpaṃ paṭisaṃharitvā attano dibbarūpeneva aṭṭhāsi.
Brāhmaṇo pana taṃ anoloketvā māṇavavohāreneva voharanto “saccaṃ kho vadesi māṇavā”tiādimāha.
Tattha candaṃ viya dārako rudanti candaṃ abhipatthayaṃ rudanto dārako viyāti attho.
Atha brāhmaṇo sokaṃ vinodetvā attano upadesadāyakaṃ dibbarūpena ṭhitaṃ disvā “ko nāma tvan”ti pucchanto –
Ko vā tvaṃ kassa vā putto, kathaṃ jānemu taṃ mayan”ti.
“Yañca kandasi yañca rodasi, puttaṃ āḷāhane sayaṃ dahitvā;
Svāhaṃ kusalaṃ karitvā kammaṃ, tidasānaṃ sahabyataṃ gato”ti.
Tattha yañca kandasi yañca rodasīti yaṃ tava puttaṃ maṭṭhakuṇḍaliṃ uddissa rodasi, assūni muñcasi.
“Appaṃ vā bahuṃ vā nāddasāma, dānaṃ dadantassa sake agāre;
Uposathakammaṃ vā tādisaṃ, kena kammena gatosi devalokan”ti.
Buddhaṃ vigatarajaṃ vitiṇṇakaṅkhaṃ, addakkhiṃ sugataṃ anomapaññaṃ.
Tāhaṃ kusalaṃ karitvāna kammaṃ, tidasānaṃ sahabyataṃ gato”ti.
Evaṃ tasmiṃ kathenteyeva brāhmaṇassa sakalasarīraṃ pītiyā paripūri.
Tattha anabhiṇhappavattitāya accharaṃ paharituṃ yogganti acchariyaṃ, abhūtapubbatāya abbhutaṃ.
Ubhayenapi vimhayāvahataṃyeva dassetvā “ahampi muditamano pasannacitto, ajjeva buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ vajāmī”ti āha.
Atha naṃ devaputto saraṇagamane sīlasamādāne ca niyojento –
“Ajjeva buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ vajāhi, dhammañca saṅghañca pasannacitto;
Tatheva sikkhāya padāni pañca, akhaṇḍaphullāni samādiyassu.
Amajjapo mā ca musā bhaṇāhi, sakena dārena ca hohi tuṭṭho”ti.
Tattha tathevāti yathā pasannacitto “sammāsambuddho bhagavā”ti buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ vajesi, tatheva “svākkhāto dhammo, suppaṭipanno saṅgho”ti pasannacitto dhammañca saṅghañca saraṇaṃ vajāhi.

Yathā vā pasannacitto ratanattayaṃ saraṇaṃ vajesi, tatheva “ayaṃ ekaṃsato diṭṭheva dhamme abhisamparāyañca hitasukhāvaho”ti pasannacitto sikkhāya adhisīlasikkhāya padāni koṭṭhāsabhūtāni adhicittaadhipaññāsikkhāya vā upāyabhūtāni pañcasīlāni avikopanato ca asaṃkilissanato ca akhaṇḍaphullāni samādiyassu, samādāya vattassūti attho.
